Maya (CS): Hi team — kicking off onboarding for AcmeCorp (Priya on thread). Goal: enable prod integration by 30 days, reduce inference cost ~20% via batching/quantization, SLA target p95 <200ms by week 6. Need clear owners and initial risks.
Priya (AcmeCorp): Thanks Maya, excited to get started. Our internal stakeholders: Priya (PM), Marcus (Infra), Lena (Legal). Success metrics we care about: 80% of requests <250ms, <2% error rate, and enablement + runbook handed over.
Aiden (AE): I'll own exec comms and renewal touches. Weekly 30-min sync works for me — propose Tue 10am PT recurring.
Sam (Solutions): I'll lead enablement + integration guide. Proposal: 3 sessions (infra integration, prompt engineering, monitoring/alerts). I'll upload slides and starter repo.
Luis (Eng): We'll need a staging sandbox, VPN access, and API keys. @OnboardBot please kick off a provisioning ticket for a dedicated sandbox for AcmeCorp. Also need model selection sign-off from Priya.
OnboardBot: Provision request received. Ticket #CS-32841 created, owner: eng-ops, ETA ~36h.
Maya (CS): Timeline (draft): week1 -> sandbox + discovery spike; week2 -> model hookup + basic traffic; week3 -> perf tuning & cache/batching; week4 -> go-live prep and cutover checklist. Major risk: renewal watch — if we're not demonstrating value by week 6, execs may reconsider. Capture feedback via weekly pulse + 1-question NPS at day 30.
Priya (AcmeCorp): Agreed. Also note: Legal needs data retention & privacy docs before week3 for our compliance review. Marcus will coordinate with your infra team.
Luis (Eng): @Priya noted. I'll share KMS/HSM + network diagram by Friday. Quick API example for their infra team:
```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-v1", "input":"hello"}'
```
Aiden (AE): Flagging renewal risk item: AcmeCorp has a competitor PoC. We'll track adoption: if usage <5k tokens/day by day 21, trigger escalation and additional enablement.
Sam (Solutions): Tentative enablement slots: Tue 4/15 11am PT (infra), Thu 4/17 2pm PT (dev), Tue 4/22 11am PT (ops). Priya please confirm availability.
Priya (AcmeCorp): Confirm Tue 4/15 and Tue 4/22. Thu 4/17 conflicts with our all-hands; can we move that to Wed 4/16 2pm instead?
Maya (CS): Updated in my calendar. I'll own the recap notes and action tracker in the CS workspace. Action items list: 1) OnboardBot create public ticket board for this engagement; 2) Luis: sandbox + KMS doc by Fri; 3) Sam: enablement materials + repo; 4) Aiden: exec check-in cadence + renewal watch playbook; 5) Priya: final stakeholder roster + on-call runbooks. Please ping if anything else. :thumbsup:
Luis (Eng): Working on the sandbox tasks now — will post VPN steps and credentials to the ticket once ready.
OnboardBot: Public board created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-32841?filter=acmecorp (private to involved parties).
Maya (CS): Thanks everyone — let's aim to close discovery questions by EOD Fri so week1 can be focused on integration.
